tables.title: Wish (الأمنيات في الحاضر)
rows: I wish I had a car.
I wish I could play the piano.
tables.explanation: نستخدم 'wish' عندما نتمنى أن يكون الواقع مختلفاً عن ما هو عليه الآن. الصيغة: Subject + wish + (that) + Subject + Past Simple. الحالات: (1) شيء لا نملكه: had. (2) شيء نريد تغييره: wasn't/weren't. (3) قدرة لا نملكها: could.
tables.examples:
I don't have a car. → I wish I had a car.
I can't play the piano. → I wish I could play the piano.
I'm at work. → I wish I wasn't at work.
It's winter. → I wish it wasn't winter.
I'm ill. → I wish I wasn't ill.
I don't have new shoes. → I wish I had new shoes.
I can't afford to go on holiday. → I wish I could afford to go on holiday.
I don't have time to read lots of books. → I wish I had time to read lots of books.

tables.title: Reported Speech (الكلام المنقول)
rows: He asked if I was leaving.
She said that she liked classical music.
He said that he didn't like tea.
He told me to open the door.
He told me not to open the door.
tables.explanation: عند نقل كلام شخص آخر نغير: (1) الزمن إلى الماضي، (2) الضمائر، (3) ظروف الزمان والمكان. تغيير الزمن: Present Simple → Past Simple، Present Continuous → Past Continuous، Past Simple → Past Perfect، Present Perfect → Past Perfect، will → would، can → could. تغيير ظروف الزمان والمكان: today → that day، tomorrow → the next day، yesterday → the previous day، now → then، here → there.
tables.examples:
"Are the boys reading the book?" → Mandy asked if the boys were reading the book.
"Is Tim leaving on Friday?" → Robert asked if Tim was leaving on Friday.
"Will it rain tomorrow?" → Daniel asked if it would rain the next day.
"Where do you play football?" → Jennifer wanted to know where I played football.
"Why didn't Nick go to New York last summer?" → Nancy asked why Nick hadn't gone to New York the previous summer.
"Did Max fly to London two weeks ago?" → Linda wanted to know if Max had flown to London two weeks before.
"I liked classical music when I was at school." → She said that she liked classical music when she was at school.
"We stayed in a big hotel." → She told me that they stayed in a big hotel.
"They have been to France for a month." → Mark told us that they had been to France for a month.
"Where is the post office?" → He asked where the post office was.

tables.title: Passive Voice (المبني للمجهول)
rows: The house was built by workers.
The cake is baked by the chef.
The letter will be sent tomorrow.
tables.explanation: قاعدة المبني للمجهول: المفعول به يصبح فاعلاً، نضيف was/were حسب الفاعل الجديد، نضع الفعل في التصريف الثالث، و(اختيارياً) نضيف by + الفاعل الأصلي.
tables.examples:
The chef baked a cake. → A cake was baked by the chef.
The workers built a new house. → A new house was built by the workers.
The school manager advised students. → Students were advised by the school manager.
Mum drank a lot of coffee. → A lot of coffee was drunk by Mum.

tables.title: Question Tags (أسئلة توكيدية)
rows: He didn't recognize me, did he?
I am good at math, aren't I?
tables.explanation: سؤال قصير يوضع في نهاية الجملة لتأكيد المعلومة أو طلب التأكيد. إذا كانت الجملة مثبتة → السؤال التوكيدي منفي. إذا كانت الجملة منفية → السؤال التوكيدي مثبت. يتكون من: فعل مساعد + ضمير.
tables.examples:
The car isn't in the garage, is it?
You are John, aren't you?
She went to the library yesterday, didn't she?
He didn't recognize me, did he?
Cars pollute the environment, don't they?
Mr. Pritchard has been to Scotland recently, hasn't he?
The trip is very expensive, isn't it?
He won't tell her, will he?
Huda had a red car, hadn't she?

tables.title: Relative Pronouns (ضمائر الوصل)
rows: The man who helped me was kind.
The book which I read was interesting.
The woman whose bag was stolen went to the police.
The man whom I saw was tall.
tables.explanation: ضمائر الوصل تستخدم لربط جملتين. who: للشخص فاعلاً. which: للجماد أو الحيوان. whose: للملكية. whom: للشخص مفعولاً به.
tables.examples:
He wore a mask which made him look like Mickey Mouse.
She came with a friend who waited outside.
The woman who gave him the money was young.
The bag which contained the money was yellow.
The woman whose bag was stolen went to the police station.

tables.title: Past Simple vs Past Continuous
rows: I was standing when something hit me.
tables.explanation: Past Simple: حدث منفصل ومكتمل. Past Continuous: حدث كان مستمراً عندما قطعه حدث آخر. غالباً ما يأتي مع while + Past Continuous (الحدث الطويل) و Past Simple (الحدث القصير الذي قطعه).
tables.examples:
One night I heard a lot of noise.
I went to see what was wrong.
Without thinking I ran into the house.
While I was standing, something hit me.
The fire brigade pulled me out of the house.
The woman was there and she said, 'It's all right.'

tables.title: Pronouns (الضمائر)
tables.explanation: ضمائر الفاعل (Subject Pronouns): تأتي قبل الفعل. صفات الملكية (Possessive Adjectives): تأتي قبل الاسم لتدل على الملكية.
tables.examples:
You have to fill in your personal details.
It's important to learn their language.
Sami will be happy if he gets high marks.
We shouldn't be limited to friends living in our neighbourhood.
